Echoes of the Empire'' |writer=[[Ethan Sacks]]{{WebCite|url=https://sacks-appeal.beehiiv.com/p/back-to-batuu-echoes-of-the-empire|text=Back to Batuu: ECHOES OF THE EMPIRE|author=[[Ethan Sacks]]|date=2026-01-15|work=[https://www.beehiiv.com/ beehiv]|archivedate=20260116045904}} |penciller=*[[Roi Mercado]] *[[Jethro Morales]] |inker= |letterer= |colorist= |cover artist=[[Phil Noto]] |editor= |publisher=[[Marvel Comics]] |start date=[[April 22]], [[2026]] |end date=[[August 19]], 2026{{WebCite|url=https://aiptcomics.com/2026/05/21/full-august-2026-marvel-comics-solicitations|text=Full August 2026 Marvel Comics solicitations: Spider-Man #1000, Midnight X-Men, and more|archivedate=20260523040656}} |schedule= |format=Miniseries |issues=5 |timeline=*[[34 ABY]]The events of ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire]]'' take place while the [[Resistance]] is on [[Batuu]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. *Between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]] {{C|Flashbacks}}The flashback events of ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire]]'' take place between the events of {{Film|V}} and {{Film|VI}}, which corresponds to between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire''''' is a [[2026]] [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries that takes place between [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Episode VIII: The Last Jedi'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker'']] (with flashbacks occurring between [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Episode VII: The Force Awakens'']]) as part of the [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge (media project)|multimedia project]] to be set during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. The series was written by [[Ethan Sacks]], illustrated by [[Roi Mercado]] and [[Jethro Morales]], with the [[Galaxy's Edge – Echoes of the Empire 1|first issue]] published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[April 22]], 2026.
